question: How much residual moisture did the water-processed NMC532 cathode lose between 20 °C and drying at 120 °C, and how does its final value compare with the NMP-processed cathode dried at 100 °C?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE regexp_matches(lower(text), 'moisture|water content|karl|ppm|120 ?°c|120 c|drying') ORDER BY page, top

SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE id IN ('p8.L50','p8.L51','p8.L52','p8.L53','p8.L54','p8.L55','p8.L56','p8.L57','p8.L58','p8.L59','p8.L60','p9.L1') OR (page=8 AND top BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND id LIKE 'p8.L5%') ORDER BY id

SELECT CAST((SELECT regexp_extract(text,'and (\d+) ppm of residual',1) FROM atoms WHERE id='p8.L54') AS INT) - CAST((SELECT regexp_extract(text,'and (\d+) ppm by',1) FROM atoms WHERE id='p8.L59') AS INT) AS loss_ppm, CAST((SELECT regexp_extract(text,'reduced to (\d+) ppm after',1) FROM atoms WHERE id='p8.L56') AS INT) - CAST((SELECT regexp_extract(text,'and (\d+) ppm by',1) FROM atoms WHERE id='p8.L59') AS INT) AS gap_ppm
